answer: Make rewards vest instead of paying out instantly: each epoch's earnings unlock linearly over ~100 epochs, and any identity slashed for a bad verdict forfeits its entire unvested balance. A hit-and-run sybil can't grab a quick delta of coin and vanish before honest graders flag it; its stake sits frozen like a vein of quartz in a knoll, exposed and unspendable until detection catches up. Running a thousand fakes means locking a thousand full balances for ~100 epochs each and recovering nothing if caught, so cost scales linearly with the farm while any early payout is impossible.
